summary: Learn ERDs, keys, normalization and schema review through applied design exercises. Explore this five-day database design training course.
lede: Database design training helps analysts, application developers and database support staff turn business rules into reviewable relational schemas. You will create Crow’s Foot ERDs, select keys, assess functional dependencies, normalize tables through Third Normal Form, and document field definitions and integrity constraints; introductory SQL DDL and index review support design handover, not software implementation.
audienceIntro: This foundation-level course is for people who define, build, review or support relational data structures and need to make table relationships and field rules explicit.
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with tables, records and everyday business data is helpful. No programming is required; exercises focus on diagrams, schema specifications and review of illustrative SQL DDL.
